title: Three Nights and One Short Ladder
subtitle: 文学故事 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学故事（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·文学与故事）
meta: 主题语境：文学故事（人与社会·文学、艺术与体育·文学与故事）　|　核心词汇：giant　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 giant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the storyteller ① described a giant that no child in the village would have forgotten, and he said the describing was the whole of the night. The ② giant, meaning the figure itself and not the shadow, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a giant, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ giant in that village had the same short ladder beside it, and the ④ giant at the far hill, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A giant, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the storyteller said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the giant was the whole of the matter, meaning the company and not the figure. The ⑥ giant, meaning the company and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; giant, he said, is either something you describe or the only word that means both a figure and a company. He said the company is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ giant had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short ladder. The ⑧ giant of the whole thing, the storyteller wrote in November, was one village and three nights of describing; giant, he said, is either the one at the far hill or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ giant I remember is the one described in the plan, which closed in 1964 and is still described as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ giant, my mother said in 1966, is the only one that improves by being described; every giant, she said, is a company that has agreed to look like a figure. She said the company was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 巨人（指村里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 巨人（指那个身影本身，与影子相对）
C. 固定搭配：describe a giant 描述一个巨人
D. n. 巨人（指留给孩子们听的那一个）
E. n. 巨人（抽象总称，指一个村子的巨人故事之事）
F. n. 巨人（指故事本里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 巨头；大公司（指一件事里人人都提却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 巨头地位（抽象总称，指人人都提却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: described a giant that no child in the village would have forgotten
The giant, meaning the figure itself and not the shadow
the giant at the far hill
the giant was the whole of the matter
the giant had become a line in a plan
The giant of the whole thing
A giant, my mother said in 1966

answers.why: describe a giant 意为“描述一个巨人”，1958 年那位说书人描述了村子里没有一位孩子会忘记的一个巨人。
giant 意为“巨人”，指那个身影本身而不是影子，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
giant 意为“巨人”，指村子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一架矮矮的梯子。
giant 意为“巨人”，指最远那座山上留给孩子们听的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
giant 意为“巨头、大公司”，指一件事里人人都提却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这家巨头企业就是那件事的全部。
giant 意为“巨头地位”，指人人都提却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个巨人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
giant 意为“巨人”，指故事本里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1962 年这一个成了本子里的一行。
giant 意为“巨人”，说书人十一月写道，整件事的巨人故事之事是一个村子和三个夜晚的描述。
giant 意为“巨人”，我记得的是本子里描述过的那一个，1964 年讲完了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一个。
giant 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，一个巨人是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
